title: Hold a utility licence to generate or transmit electricity
what: Provide a utility service, including the capacity to generate 30 MW or more connected to a network, or the transmission or distribution of electricity through a network, only under a licence.

sources.title: Utilities Act 2000 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 21(1) (current republication (R71, from 26 November 2025; Utilities Act 2000 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person must not provide a utility service except in accordance with a licence

sources.title: Utilities Act 2000 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 6 (current republication (R71, from 26 November 2025; Utilities Act 2000 | Acts))
sources.quote: each of the following is a utility service: (a) the distribution of electricity through an electricity network; (b) an electricity connection service; (c) the capacity to generate 30MW or more of power connected to an electricity network

sources.title: Utilities Act 2000 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 25, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current republication (R71, from 26 November 2025; Utilities Act 2000 | Acts)
sources.quote: any other condition stated in the licence by ICRC that is not inconsistent with a requirement of, or under, this Act or any other law of the Territory.

reach.condition: if it has 30 MW or more of generating capacity connected to a network, or transmits or distributes electricity
